description: Sleep session: one night from a Fitbit in the Google Health format, with stage totals, the algorithm version, an offset and the source-supplied score (health v2.10)
notes: The source id exceeds 2^53 and is carried as a string with its id space named. Google supplies an offset and no zone name, so health:utcOffset is written and health:timeZone is not. No in-bed total: Fitbit records none, and the session interval is the time in bed. Fully synthetic.
